## crown

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE isolated gold coin sprite for a medieval Western fantasy pixel-art action RPG. Intended final size exactly 32x32 logical pixels. Create a very simple readable sprite rendered enlarged on a square transparent canvas. A single centered circular coin about 26 logical pixels in diameter, front view, slight visible bottom/right thickness. Crisp square pixel clusters, deliberate 32x32 pixel grid, limited palette 6-8 warm gold/ochre colors with dark brown outline, pale yellow upper-left highlight and dark amber lower-right shading. Style matches small cute blue/green slime monsters, a blue-and-gold armored knight, grassy pixel terrain and wooden crates. Keep rim and central relief chunky and legible at tiny size. Centered fully visible coin with generous transparent padding. No letters or numbers, no glow, no sparkle, no cast shadow outside the coin, no checkerboard, no text, no UI, no multiple coins, no scene. Central relief: a very simple medieval royal crown with three large points.
